articles.title_en: Take-up of Social Benefits: Experimental Evidence from France
articles.title_cn: 社会福利的领取：来自法国的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: We report on two nationwide experiments with job seekers in France. We first show that a meeting with social services to assess eligibility and help with applications to social benefits increased new benefit take-up by 29 percent. By contrast, an online simulator that gave personalized information on benefit eligibility did not increase take-up. Marginal treatment effects show that individuals who benefit the most from the meetings are the least likely to attend. Overall, without ruling out information frictions, our results suggest that transaction costs represent the main obstacle to applying for benefits or accessing government’s assistance in applying. (JEL D83, I38, J22, J65, R38)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们报告了在法国对求职者进行的两项全国性实验。我们首先表明，与社会服务机构会面以评估资格并帮助申请社会福利，使新福利领取增加了29%。相比之下，一个提供个性化福利资格信息的在线模拟器并未增加领取率。边际处理效应显示，从会面中获益最多的个体最不可能参加。总体而言，在不排除信息摩擦的情况下，我们的结果表明，交易成本是申请福利或获取政府申请援助的主要障碍。(JEL D83, I38, J22, J65, R38)

articles.title_en: Labor Supply Responses and Adjustment Frictions: A Tax-Free Year in Iceland
articles.title_cn: 劳动力供给响应与调整摩擦：冰岛的免税年
articles.abstract_en: Labor income earned in Iceland in 1987 went untaxed. I use this episode to study labor supply responses to temporary wage changes. Using a population-wide dataset of earnings and working time and two identification strategies, I estimate intensive and extensive margin Frisch elasticities of 0.4 and 0.09, respectively. Workers with the ability to adjust drive these average responses: extensive margin by young and close-to-retirement cohorts and intensive margin responses by workers in temporally flexible jobs, though secondary jobs contribute to one-tenth of the response. The results suggest that adjustment frictions may similarly explain differences in elasticities within and across countries. (JEL H24, H31, J22)
articles.abstract_cn: 1987年冰岛赚取的劳动收入未被征税。我利用这一事件来研究劳动力对临时工资变化的供给响应。使用涵盖收入和工时的全人口数据集以及两种识别策略，我估计了集约边际和广延边际的弗里希弹性分别为0.4和0.09。具有调整能力的工人推动了这些平均响应：广延边际由年轻和接近退休的群体驱动，集约边际响应来自时间灵活工作的工人，尽管次要工作贡献了响应的十分之一。结果表明，调整摩擦可能同样解释了国家内部和国家之间的弹性差异。（JEL H24, H31, J22）

articles.title_en: The Semblance of Success in Nudging Consumers to Pay Down Credit Card Debt
articles.title_cn: 推动消费者偿还信用卡债务的表面成功
articles.abstract_en: We test a nudge in a field experiment on credit cards. The nudge shrouds the autopay enrollment option for cardholders to automatically pay exactly the credit card minimum payment each month. After six months, the nudge decreases the fraction of cardholders who only pay exactly the minimum by 23 percent. However, the nudge does not significantly reduce credit card debt. Nudged cardholders often choose autopay amounts that are only slightly higher than the minimum payment. The nudge reduces autopay enrollment, which increases missed payments. The nudge reduces manual payments by autopay enrollees. Cardholders frequently lacking liquid cash best explains our results. (JEL C93, D12, D91, G21, G51)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在信用卡现场实验中测试了一种助推。该助推隐藏了持卡人自动支付选项，使其每月自动支付恰好为信用卡最低还款额。六个月后，该助推使仅支付最低还款额的持卡人比例下降了23%。然而，该助推并未显著减少信用卡债务。受到助推的持卡人常常选择的自动支付金额仅略高于最低还款额。该助推减少了自动支付的注册，从而增加了逾期付款。该助推减少了自动支付注册者的手动支付。持卡人经常缺乏流动现金最能解释我们的结果。（JEL C93, D12, D91, G21, G51）

articles.title_en: Does Getting Forecasts Earlier Matter? Evidence from Winter Advisories and Vehicle Crashes
articles.title_cn: 提前获得预报是否重要？来自冬季预警与车辆碰撞的证据
articles.abstract_en: Significant investments are directed toward improving the accuracy and early availability of forecasts. However, the value of longer lead times on forecasts is unclear. Using data on winter weather advisories and vehicle crashes in the United States, I show that advisories with longer lead times reduce crashes, even when they are less accurate than advisories with shorter lead times. Further, marginal benefits do not decrease with lead time. The benefits come from individual and institutional responses. When advisories arrive earlier, people visit fewer places, and snowplow crews intensify the road maintenance operations. These results have policy implications for providing effective forecasts. (JEL Q54, Q58, R41)
articles.abstract_cn: 大量投资被用于提高预报的准确性和提前可获得性。然而，更长提前期的预报价值尚不明确。利用美国冬季天气预警和车辆碰撞的数据，我表明，即使提前期较长的预警不如提前期较短的预警准确，它们也能减少碰撞事故。此外，边际效益并不随提前期增加而减少。这些效益来自个人和机构的响应。当预警提前到达时，人们减少出行次数，扫雪队伍加强道路维护作业。这些结果对提供有效预报具有政策意义。（JEL Q54, Q58, R41）

articles.title_en: Social Welfare Portability and Migration: Evidence from India’s Public Distribution System
articles.title_cn: 社会福利可携带性与迁移：来自印度公共分配系统的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies a new program designed to make food entitlements portable throughout India. We first characterize the state of food entitlement portability using mystery shoppers and surveys of migrants and distributors. We then inform households about the program—and barriers to using it—through a cluster randomized controlled trial. Treatment impacts on beliefs about entitlement portability were initially positive but later turned negative following a general rise in beliefs. These patterns are consistent with our experiment increasing awareness of the program but decreasing trust in its implementation. Migration to cities decreased, suggesting access to food affects migrants’ destination choices. (JEL D12, D83, H53, I38, O12, O18, R23)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一项旨在使印度食品权益可携带的新项目。我们首先通过神秘顾客以及针对移民和分销商的调查来刻画食品权益可携带性的现状。随后，我们通过一项整群随机对照试验，向家庭告知该项目及其使用障碍。处理组对权益可携带性信念的影响最初是积极的，但在普遍信念上升后转为负面。这些模式与我们的实验提高了对该项目的认识但降低了对其实施的信任度相一致。向城市的迁移减少了，这表明食品获取影响移民的目的地选择。(JEL D12, D83, H53, I38, O12, O18, R23)

articles.title_en: Disrupting Drug Markets: The Effects of Crackdowns on Rogue Opioid Suppliers
articles.title_cn: 扰乱毒品市场：打击非法阿片类药物供应商的效果
articles.abstract_en: This paper estimates the impact of doctor crackdowns on the quantity demanded of prescription opioids, across-market substitution, and across-product substitution. Exploiting plausibly exogenous variation in the timing and location of administrative actions, I find cracking down on a single doctor decreases county-level opioid dispensing by 10 percent. This decline persists across space and grows over time. Additionally, significant heroin substitution occurs, yet overall overdose mortality decreases. These results highlight a critical tradeoff policymakers should consider with targeted crackdowns: Reductions in the flow of new users must be balanced against the harm that arises when existing users substitute to more dangerous drugs. (JEL I11, I12, I18, K42)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文估计了医生打击行动对处方阿片类药物需求量、跨市场替代和跨产品替代的影响。利用行政行动时间和地点的看似外生变化，我发现打击单个医生会使县级阿片类药物配发量减少10%。这一下降在空间上持续存在，并随时间增长。此外，出现了显著的海洛因替代，但总体过量死亡率下降。这些结果凸显了政策制定者在定向打击时应考虑的关键权衡：新使用者流量的减少必须与现有使用者转向更危险药物时产生的危害相平衡。(JEL I11, I12, I18, K42)

articles.title_en: The Not-So-Uniform Effects of Trade Secret Protection on Business Entry
articles.title_cn: 商业秘密保护对企业进入的非统一效应
articles.abstract_en: We explore the consequences of trade secret protection for new business formation in the United States. We find the states that adopt the Uniform Trade Secrets Act (UTSA), which enhances intellectual property rights, experience an overall decline in firm and establishment entry rates. This result is driven by the reduction in the establishment entry rates of start-ups and small firms. By contrast, the law increases the establishment entry rates of incumbents and larger firms. The negative impact of the UTSA is larger in industries that rely more on intellectual assets and trade secrets, as well as external-finance-dependent industries. (JEL K11, K22, L11, M13, O34, O38)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们探讨了商业秘密保护对美国新企业形成的影响。我们发现，采用《统一商业秘密法》（UTSA）以增强知识产权的州，其企业和机构进入率总体下降。这一结果是由初创企业和小型企业的机构进入率降低所驱动的。相比之下，该法律提高了现有企业和大型企业的机构进入率。UTSA的负面影响在更依赖知识资产和商业秘密的行业以及依赖外部融资的行业中更为显著。（JEL K11, K22, L11, M13, O34, O38）

articles.title_en: The Management of Aid and Conflict in Africa
articles.abstract_en: This study investigates the relationship between the management of development aid and violent conflict in Africa. I exploit variation in World Bank project management quality driven by the assignment of project leaders of varying ability, combined with geo-coded data on all projects linked to performance report cards. I find that better project management reduces violent conflict across subnational aid receiving regions. Poorly managed projects increase conflict while well-managed projects do the opposite. Project monitoring is particularly important, and management matters most in regions with a recent history of warfare and for large projects that involve the transfer of appropriable resources. (JEL D74, F35, O17, O19, O22)
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了发展援助管理与非洲暴力冲突之间的关系。我利用世界银行项目管理质量的变化，这种变化由不同能力的项目负责人分配所驱动，并结合所有项目的地理编码数据与绩效报告卡。我发现，更好的项目管理减少了次国家级援助接收地区的暴力冲突。管理不善的项目增加了冲突，而管理良好的项目则相反。项目监测尤为重要，管理在近期有战争历史的地区以及涉及可挪用资源转移的大型项目中影响最大。(JEL D74, F35, O17, O19, O22)

articles.title_en: Place Effects and Geographic Inequality in Health at Birth
articles.title_cn: 出生地效应与出生健康的地理不平等
articles.abstract_en: This paper uses birth records and mothers who move to quantify the absolute and relative importance of birth location for early-life health. Using a model that includes mother and location fixed effects, we find that moving from a below- to an above-median-birth-weight location leads to important improvements in child birth weight, with comparable magnitudes to policies targeting maternal health. Place effects are larger for longer-distance moves and more influential for children of non-college-educated mothers. We find that pollution is the strongest predictor of place effects on infant health. (JEL I12, I14, J13, J16, Q51, Q53)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用出生记录和迁移母亲的数据，量化出生地点对早期健康绝对和相对的重要性。通过一个包含母亲和地点固定效应的模型，我们发现，从出生体重低于中位数的地区迁移到高于中位数的地区，会显著改善婴儿出生体重，其影响程度与针对孕产妇健康的政策相当。地点效应在长途迁移中更为显著，并且对未受过大学教育的母亲的子女影响更大。我们发现，污染是婴儿健康地点效应最强的预测因子。（JEL I12, I14, J13, J16, Q51, Q53）

articles.title_en: Local Labor Market Effects of the 2002 Bush Steel Tariffs
articles.title_cn: 2002年布什钢铁关税的本地劳动力市场效应
articles.abstract_en: President George W. Bush imposed safeguard tariffs on steel in early 2002. Using US input-output tables and a generalized difference-in-difference methodology, we analyze the local labor market employment effects of these tariffs depending on the local labor market’s reliance on steel as an input and as part of local production. The tariffs did not boost local steel employment but substantially depressed local employment in steel-consuming industries for many years after Bush removed them. The tariffs also led to a persistent exit of steel-intensive manufacturing establishments, suggesting a role for plant-level fixed entry costs in translating the temporary shock into persistent outcomes. (JEL F13, L61, R23)
articles.abstract_cn: 乔治·W·布什总统于2002年初对钢铁实施了保障性关税。利用美国投入产出表和广义双重差分法，我们分析了这些关税对本地劳动力市场就业的影响，具体取决于本地劳动力市场对钢铁作为投入品及本地生产一部分的依赖程度。这些关税并未提升本地钢铁就业，但在布什取消关税后的多年里，显著抑制了钢铁消费行业的本地就业。关税还导致钢铁密集型制造业企业持续退出，这表明工厂层面的固定进入成本在将暂时性冲击转化为持续性结果中发挥了作用。(JEL F13, L61, R23)

articles.title_en: Public Financing and Racial Disparities: Does a Rising Tide Always Lift All Boats?
articles.title_cn: 公共融资与种族差异：水涨船高是否总能惠及所有船只？
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the heterogeneous impact of local government spending across racial groups. An exogenous increase in spending results in significant improvement in White, but not Black or Hispanic, labor market outcomes such as employment rate, weekly hours worked, and labor income. These effects on adults translate into their children’s academic performance. White students show significant improvement in test scores, but Black or Hispanic students do not. Consequently, the achievement racial gap widens following an increase in local government spending. These results highlight the possibility that an increase in local government spending could unexpectedly increase intergenerational racial disparity. (JEL H74, H75, I22, I26, J15, J22, J31)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了地方政府支出在不同种族群体间的异质性影响。外生性支出增加导致白人劳动力市场结果显著改善，如就业率、每周工作小时数和劳动收入，但黑人或西班牙裔并未改善。这些对成年人的影响转化为其子女的学业表现。白人学生的考试成绩显著提高，但黑人或西班牙裔学生没有。因此，在地方政府支出增加后，学业种族差距扩大。这些结果凸显了地方政府支出增加可能意外加剧代际种族差异的可能性。(JEL H74, H75, I22, I26, J15, J22, J31)

articles.title_en: Do Tuition Subsidies Raise Political Participation?
articles.title_cn: 学费补贴能否提高政治参与？
articles.abstract_en: Civic externalities motivate education expenditures, but estimates of the civic returns to large-scale education subsidies are scarce. We use 16 million financial aid applications and a regression discontinuity (RD) design to estimate how a tuition-free college program impacts political participation. We find that each of the 2.6 million awards increased a student’s voter turnout rate by 4–12 percentage points in 2020, raising total turnout and Biden’s margin of victory in the awarding state. We find evidence consistent with peer socialization, among other mechanisms, and show that the civic externalities of education spending can be large enough to sway elections. (JEL D72, D91, I22, I23)
articles.abstract_cn: 公民外部性为教育支出提供了动机，但关于大规模教育补贴的公民回报的估计却很少。我们利用16万份财政援助申请和断点回归（RD）设计，估计了一项免学费大学项目对政治参与的影响。我们发现，每2.6万份奖励在4年将学生的投票率提高了12-2020个百分点，提高了该州的总体投票率和拜登的胜选优势。我们发现了与同伴社会化等机制相一致的证据，并表明教育支出的公民外部性可能大到足以左右选举。（JEL D72, D91, I22, I23）

articles.title_en: Do Medical Treatments Work for Work? Evidence from Breast Cancer Patients
articles.title_cn: 医疗治疗对工作有效吗？来自乳腺癌患者的证据
articles.abstract_en: We investigate the effects of radiation therapy on the mortality and economic outcomes of breast cancer patients. We implement a 2SLS strategy within a difference-in-difference framework exploiting variation in treatment stemming from a medical guideline change in Denmark. We reproduce the results from an RCT showing the lifesaving benefits of radiotherapy. We show radiation therapy also has economic returns: Ten years after diagnosis, treatment increases employment by 37 percent and earnings by 45 percent. Previous work has documented a substantial employment drop after a breast cancer diagnosis. Our results imply that radiation therapy can reduce this effect by 70 percent. (JEL H51, I12, I18, J16, J22, J31)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了放射治疗对乳腺癌患者死亡率和经济结果的影响。我们在双重差分框架内实施2SLS策略，利用丹麦医疗指南变更引起的治疗变异。我们重现了随机对照试验的结果，显示放疗的救命益处。我们表明放疗也具有经济回报：诊断后十年，治疗使就业率提高37%，收入提高45%。先前的研究记录了乳腺癌诊断后就业的大幅下降。我们的结果表明，放疗可以将这种影响减少70%。（JEL H51, I12, I18, J16, J22, J31）
